query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat9) as totalFaturado,
  SUM(cat1) as totalAvulso,
  SUM(cat2) as totalClube,
  SUM(cat9) as totalDpote,
  COUNT(*) as qtdDias
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data LIKE '2026-05-%'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
